thread:
Miguel (AE): FYI FinEdge pushed back on our SIG/CAIQ answers. They want a KMS BYOK option for hosted API and are asking for a formal exception if we can't provide it by POC start next week.
Alex (SE): Do they mean per-customer HSM keys, or just customer-managed KMS in their cloud?
Miguel (AE): They specifically said 'per-tenant HSM-backed keys' and that their compliance team won't sign without it.
Priya (InfoSec): That's a hard blocker for hosted. Our documented KMS/HSM integration is for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) only.
Alex (SE): Right — hosted API currently offers server-side keys we manage. We can offer tightened controls (dedicated customer namespace, stricter audit logging) but not HSM-backed BYOK on hosted.
Miguel (AE): Customer says POC can't be delayed. They're asking for compensating controls and a formal risk acceptance signed by security/legal.
Priya (InfoSec): OK. Proposed compensating controls we can offer for the hosted POC (temporary):
- Dedicated project/namespace + strict tenant routing
- IP allowlist for all POC traffic
- TLS with mutual auth for ingestion endpoints
- Enhanced logging + delivery of audit logs to their S3 on a daily push
- Short retention of ephemeral keys and daily rotation
- Penetration test cert from third party (if they accept)

Alex (SE): I'll map those to the questionnaire answers and mark the KMS question as "Exception granted with compensating controls".
Sasha (Legal): We need an addendum: 90-day remediation timeline, acceptance of residual risk, and indemnity language? Also need to confirm any escrow/EULA notes.
Priya (InfoSec): I can approve a limited risk acceptance for the POC only if the controls are in place and we get sign-off on the addendum. Also require monthly risk review and SLA to revert to Private or ship BYOK within 90 days.
Miguel (AE): I already told them we can do a 90-day window. They want it in writing.
sec-bot: <https://redwood.internal/risks/templates/risk-acceptance-form-v2> — template prefilled for "FinEdge POC KMS exception".
Sasha (Legal): I'll review the prefilled form now. Miguel, send any required commercial notes (discounts, start/end dates).
Alex (SE): QA note: for the audit logs push to customer S3 we'll need a signed S3 bucket policy and one-time credentials. Can engineering ops stand up the push?
Priya (InfoSec): Ops can handle daily pushes and mutual-TLS. I'll coordinate with eng-ops and require encrypted transfer and HMAC verification of payloads.
Miguel (AE): FinEdge asked if this exception will affect other customers or our security posture public page. They want it isolated to their contract.
Priya (InfoSec): Exception scoped to FinEdge POC only; we will not publish it as standard practice. Addendum language will specify single-tenant POC exception.
Sasha (Legal): Drafted addendum uploaded: <https://redwood.internal/legal/FinEdge-addendum-draft.docx>. Miguel please ask FinEdge to review and sign.
Miguel (AE): Sent to FinEdge with comments. They replied :thumbsup: and want the risk acceptance form signed by Redwood security before kickoff.
Priya (InfoSec): I'll sign the risk acceptance once eng-ops confirms the audit push and mutual-TLS are implemented. Target: sign by EOD tomorrow.
Alex (SE): I'll post a short runbook for eng-ops with the S3 push steps and mTLS cert rotation.
sec-bot: Incident log created for this exception: INC-2025-2879. Link: <https://redwood.incidents/INC-2025-2879>.
Priya (InfoSec): Approved pending implementation checks. Signing after ops confirms.
Miguel (AE): Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the deal tracker and note the POC start contingent on signed addendum and signed risk acceptance.
Sasha (Legal): Added a 30-day review clause after POC.
Alex (SE): Leaving a note for future: scope automation to detect POC-specific exceptions so we don't accidentally generalize.
Priya (InfoSec): Thanks — closing loop. If anything changes ping me directly.
